title: Ask the Guru to tend the child in you
summary: The helpless child is cherished by the Guru, and the lotus-heart opens in that water. Ask to be tended before loneliness teaches you to harden.
takeaway: Ask the Guru to tend the child in you.
lifeApplication: When loneliness makes you brace, sit with one breath of the line and ask to be nourished rather than made impressive.

source.shortMeaning: The Guru becomes Mother and Father, tending the helpless child until the lotus-heart opens.
source.lifeApplication: Let need become a prayer for tending, not a reason to shut down.

evidence.coreClaim: The Guru's care turns helpless longing into a heart that can blossom again.
evidence.turn: Loneliness softens when the childlike soul asks to be cherished by the Guru.
evidence.practicalImplication: When loneliness makes you brace, sit with one breath of the line and ask to be nourished rather than made impressive.
